4603: Tomoyo transferred to Tomoya's school as a second year student during spring. Although Tomoya is older than her, Tomoyo does not show him his due respect as a senior student. She has a younger brother named Takafumi.
4606: Tomoya Okazaki is the protagonist of Clannad. Due to his habit of always arriving late to school, skipping classes during the day, and staying out all night, he has been labeled as a delinquent.
4610: Youhei is Tomoya's friend and also a delinquent. He entered the school on an athletic recommendation in football (soccer), but was kicked out of the soccer club after being involved in a fight.
14277: A guy who came into the scene and tell Tomoya to stop dating Tomoyo, since their relationship made the society view them in a bad way. Second Grade Students' Union Member, he known as that name and Tomoyo's path. He is the vice-president of Hikarizaka's student council.
